transcript_segments.text: There are sentences I almost reach They hover just beneath release
Like mess without the push to leave Held inside what I can't speak
I feel the shape of what I mean Before it forms in anything
A constellation not just But never mapped beyond my breath
I calculate, I hesitate Too much drag, too much weight
Every word I try to send Falls back down before it bends toward you
I wonder if you ever know How close they came to breaking through
I don't reach escape velocity My thoughts collapse back into me
Carve in my own gravity Before they cross the space
Between my good others Just out of range Different life if I could say
The thing that almost made their way But never carried far enough away
I replay every almost line The ones that stole the real time
Job and reviews and quiet rooms Where better words might have result
But different versions of my name Spoken clear instead of strange relationships
That slip the frame Before articulation came too late
If I were forcing off to send Would anything have changed back then
I don't reach escape velocity My thoughts collapse back into me
Every chance that could be burned Up in proximity
We could have just passed the sight A slight adjustment
Different flight if I could push Pass what confines With something else up in my life
It's not that nothing's there
Just let it never travels Far enough to matter
Somewhere between intention And expression
There's a threshold I never cross
I don't reach escape velocity My thoughts collapse
Maybe silence is in void Just to feel I cannot afford
Where meaning gather Stands and slow But never finds the force to go
Maybe I was built this way High mass low release array
A thousand thoughts that never leave Or the tingin turnally still here
Don't reach escape velocity But something still remains in me
Not every truth is meant to be Transmeded through proximity
We could have instilled resonates And quiet upon spoken states
Not lost just helping Different ways A signal drifting over fully erased
If you felt it Even faintly If you could pull of what stayed in me
And maybe distances and laws Just a measure Of the cause
Of never leaving gravity
